subject: Request for Custom SLA Addendum & Order Form Language — AstraGenix
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@astragenix.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: AstraGenix Procurement <procurement@astragenix.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Custom SLA addendum for enterprise MSA — AstraGenix

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a formal request: AstraGenix needs a custom SLA addendum to sit alongside the MSA and order form for the pilot and eventual rollout. Key asks: 99.95% monthly uptime for production (with a clarified measurement window), latency SLOs for the embeddings endpoint (p95 < 120ms for up to 2k qps), and a defined credits schedule for downtime and degraded performance.

We also need a short evidence checklist for intake (telemetry retention, order-of-failure logs, KV cache hit rates) so our ops team can validate performance during onboarding. Procurement will want this as an attachment to the SOW and a line in the order form so finance can match invoices.

I attached our security questionnaire and a template MSA excerpt we use for riders. Could you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide the SLA addendum as an attachable exhibit to the MSA/SOW;
- Include order-form language that binds the uptime/latency targets to the SKU; and
- Commit to a 30-day DocuSign turnaround and a SOC2 evidence snapshot for the pilot period?

We'd like a working draft by EOD Monday if possible. Please loop in legal and the ops contact who will own telemetry.

Regards,
Laura Chen
Director, IT Procurement
AstraGenix Health
[Attachment: AstraGenix_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@astragenix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Custom SLA addendum for enterprise MSA — AstraGenix

Laura — thanks for the clear ask and for the questionnaire. Appreciate the timelines; we can move quickly.

Proposed immediate plan:
1) Redwood legal will produce a draft SLA addendum exhibit that can be appended to the MSA/SOW and referenced in the order form. I've attached an initial draft (internal template with placeholders).
2) Karthik (legal) will handle the credit schedule wording and any hard limits on availability exceptions.
3) Monica (customer ops) will confirm what telemetry snapshots we can provide for the pilot and the retention window.

High-level answers to your bullets:
- Yes, we can provide the SLA addendum as an attachable exhibit to the MSA/SOW;
- We can add order-form language to bind the SKU to the SLA tiering (we typically use a SKU-to-SLO mapping table); and
- We aim to meet a 30-day DocuSign turnaround; for SOC2 evidence we can provide a snapshot export for pilot verification (subject to standard redaction).

Next steps: Karthik, can you draft the credits schedule and include fallback language for regional failovers? Monica, can you confirm which telemetry fields we can commit to provide (retention period, export format)? Laura — I'll follow up with the draft addendum and a short implementation checklist by Monday EOD.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_SLA_Addendum_v0.1.docx (docx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@astragenix.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Custom SLA addendum for enterprise MSA — AstraGenix

Laura / team — I reviewed the initial draft and sketched redline notes. High-level legal positions:
- Availability metric: we prefer a monthly measurement window with a defined denominator (seconds service expected available). The 99.95% target is deliverable with the Dedicated footprint and conditional on the agreed maintenance windows.
- Latency SLO: we can commit to p95 < 120ms for the embeddings endpoint for the Tier-1 SKU at up to 2k qps; we will qualify this for specific model variants and sequence lengths (we need to pin the model family in the order form).
- Credits: propose a three-tier credit schedule (0.5%, 2%, 5% of monthly fee) tied to severity of breach and duration; see redline for exact triggers. We prefer credits over unlimited refunds; full termination rights would require higher thresholds.
- Exceptions: include a regional-fallback carve-out for force majeure and cross-region migration windows (we've included a 72-hour notification requirement).

Operational asks for Monica: please confirm telemetry export frequency (recommended: daily snapshot) and retention (90 days minimum for pilot audit). If AstraGenix needs longer retention, we can offer extended retention as an add-on.

I attached the redlined addendum for review. If all parties agree on the credit schedule and telemetry scope, I can prepare a DocuSign route and final exhibit for signature next week.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA_Addendum_Redline.docx (docx)]

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@astragenix.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: AstraGenix Procurement <procurement@astragenix.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Custom SLA addendum for enterprise MSA — AstraGenix

Thanks, Soojin and Karthik — this is exactly what procurement and ops were looking for. A few quick notes:
- The credit schedule looks reasonable. Procurement prefers definitive termination language tied to a repeated breach clause (e.g., two monthly breaches in a 6-month window). Can you include that as an option in the final exhibit?
- Ops confirms 90-day retention is sufficient for the pilot; they also asked for a simple CSV export of the daily telemetry snapshot (schema in the questionnaire).
- Please include the SKU-to-SLO mapping table in the order form as an annex; that will let finance map invoices to the SLA tier.

If you can prepare the final exhibit and the DocuSign envelope with the SOW attached, procurement can route for signature and PO issuance. HubSpot deal id is 912345 if you want to sync.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll be ready to sign once the termination option and export format are included.

Best,
Laura
Director, IT Procurement
AstraGenix Health
[Requested attachments: runbook outline for telemetry export and DocuSign envelope when ready]
